topicName: Disaster Recovery, Backup, and etcd Management (Velero)
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Disaster Recovery, Backup, and etcd Management (Velero) in Kubernetes"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Disaster recovery is a critical component of Kubernetes cluster administration. Ensuring that your application states, persistent volumes, and cluster metadata can be restored efficiently after a failure is paramount. This tutorial covers etcd backup strategies and the deployment and usage of Velero for comprehensive cluster backup and disaster recovery."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Understanding Kubernetes etcd Architecture"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"etcd is the consistent and highly-available key-value store used as Kubernetes' backing store for all cluster data. Protecting etcd is equivalent to protecting the entire control plane state."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"etcd stores API objects (Pods, Services, Deployments, Custom Resources)."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Backups can be performed manually using the etcdctl utility or automatically via scheduled scripts."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Performing a Manual etcd Backup"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"To take a snapshot of the etcd database, use the etcdctl command-line tool with proper TLS certificates matching your cluster configuration."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 --cacert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/ca.crt --cert=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.crt --key=/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd/server.key snapshot save /backup/etcd-snapshot.db"},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"3. Restoring etcd from a Snapshot"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Restoring an etcd cluster requires initializing a new member directory from a known good snapshot file."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot restore /backup/etcd-snapshot.db --data-dir=/var/lib/etcd-from-backup"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"4. Introduction to Velero for Application and Cluster Backup"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"While etcd backups capture control plane state, Velero provides a robust mechanism to back up and restore Kubernetes cluster resources and persistent volumes, supporting multi-cloud environments and object storage backends."},{"order":15,"type":"subheading","text":"5. Installing and Configuring Velero"},{"order":16,"type":"paragraph","text":"First, ensure you have the Velero CLI installed. Then, deploy Velero into your cluster using an object storage provider (such as AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob)."},{"order":17,"type":"code","text":"velero install --provider aws --plugins velero/velero-plugin-for-aws:v1.8.0 --bucket my-cluster-backup-bucket --secret-file ./credentials-velero --use-volume-snapshots=true"},{"order":18,"type":"subheading","text":"6. Creating a Backup with Velero"},{"order":19,"type":"paragraph","text":"You can back up the entire cluster or target specific namespaces. To create an on-demand backup of a namespace named production, run the following command:"},{"order":20,"type":"code","text":"velero backup create prod-backup --include-namespaces production"},{"order":21,"type":"subheading","text":"7. Scheduling Automated Backups"},{"order":22,"type":"paragraph","text":"Production environments require regular automated backups. Velero supports cron expressions to schedule recurring backups effortlessly."},{"order":23,"type":"code","text":"velero schedule create daily-backup --schedule=\"0 2 * * *\" --include-namespaces production"},{"order":24,"type":"subheading","text":"8. Restoring from Velero Backups"},{"order":25,"type":"paragraph","text":"In the event of a failure or when migrating applications to a new cluster, you can restore resources directly from a completed Velero backup."},{"order":26,"type":"code","text":"velero restore create --from-backup prod-backup"},{"order":27,"type":"subheading","text":"Summary"},{"order":28,"type":"paragraph","text":"Combining regular etcd snapshots with Velero's application-aware backup strategy ensures a comprehensive disaster recovery posture. Test your restore procedures regularly to guarantee high availability and operational readiness."}]
